needs.reason: pnpm install runs project code: hoppscotch-backend's postinstall runs prisma generate and nest start with GENERATE_GQL_SCHEMA=true to write gql-gen/backend-schema.gql, which is not in the repository; the postinstall of @hoppscotch/common, @hoppscotch/selfhost-web and hoppscotch-sh-admin runs graphql-codegen on that schema to write the git-ignored graphql.ts files their sources import; js-sandbox, kernel and data build their dist in postinstall or prepare. The Tauri crates need tauri-build and git dependencies on GitHub, and the desktop's prepare-web builds selfhost-web and runs the webapp-bundler crate

traps: pnpm-workspace.yaml says packages/** (recursive), so the members include the two Tauri plugin packages and the example app under packages/hoppscotch-desktop/plugin-workspace; the workspaces field of package.json (./packages/*) is ignored by pnpm and would miss them
the plugin-workspace packages keep their own pnpm-lock.yaml files, which pnpm ignores inside the workspace: the root pnpm-lock.yaml lists them as importers

@hoppscotch/plugin-appload and @hoppscotch/plugin-relay are npm aliases of GitHub tarballs (CuriousCorrelation/tauri-plugin-appload#7c5d9c2, tauri-plugin-relay#1461c7b), and the desktop crate takes tauri-plugin-appload and tauri-plugin-relay by git: none of them uses the in-repository copies @CuriousCorrelation/plugin-appload, @CuriousCorrelation/plugin-relay or the crates under plugin-workspace

there is no Cargo workspace: eight crates each have their own Cargo.toml, seven keep their own Cargo.lock and the example tauri-app has none; the agent takes relay by git from CuriousCorrelation/relay although a crate named relay sits in plugin-workspace/relay

hoppscotch-desktop and hoppscotch-agent are each both an npm package and a Cargo crate with the same name, and so is tauri-app in the example: connections, frameworks and unknown refer to these units by root
packages/hoppscotch-relay is a Cargo crate inside the pnpm packages/ folder with no package.json: it is not a pnpm member

packages/hoppscotch-selfhost-web/webapp-server is a Go module nested inside an npm package; go.mod asks go 1.24.0 with toolchain go1.24.1 while prod.Dockerfile downloads Go 1.26.7 and devenv.nix enables go_1_25

the GraphQL schema is code-first: the NestJS backend writes it only when it runs (GENERATE_GQL_SCHEMA=true), and three front ends generate their typed clients from ../../gql-gen/*.gql; sh-admin also depends on hoppscotch-backend as a workspace package

tsconfig paths and Vite aliases disagree: selfhost-web's vite.config.ts maps ~, @composables, @helpers and more to ../hoppscotch-common/src, which its tsconfig does not list, and @hoppscotch/common is aliased to @hoppscotch/common/src in Vite but to ../hoppscotch-common/src/index.ts in tsconfig; the tsconfig maps are given as tsconfig_paths, the Vite aliases are not listed

Node is asked in fourteen places with values from 14 (netlify.toml) to >=24.22.1-r0 (prod.Dockerfile); pnpm is 10.34.5 in packageManager and the Dockerfile but 10.15.0, 10.18.3 and 10 in the workflows
Rust is nightly in devenv.nix and the desktop workflow, stable in the agent workflow, and the plugins ask rust-version 1.77.2 and 1.85; webapp-bundler uses edition 2024
firebase.json and netlify.toml publish packages/hoppscotch-web/dist, a package that no longer exists: both deploy files are stale
the desktop build runs another build: prepare-web installs and builds hoppscotch-selfhost-web, then cargo-builds crates/webapp-bundler and runs it to pack the web dist into bundle.zip
the Tauri plugins commit their built JavaScript in dist-js/ next to guest-js/
selfhost-web's vite.config.ts aliases tailwind.config.cjs and postcss.config.cjs to ../hoppscotch-common/, where neither file exists
codemirror-lang-graphql/src/syntax.grammar is a Lezer grammar that rollup compiles into the parser index.js imports
prisma/migrations/*.sql are generated by Prisma but kept as project code; the mock_server migrations define a trigger in PL/pgSQL, so Linguist calls those files PLpgSQL and the others SQL
the backend mail templates are Handlebars (.hbs); the agent serves an HTTP API on localhost:9119 that @hoppscotch/common calls as an interceptor
languages lists programming and markup languages only; JSON, YAML, TOML and Markdown files are present and not listed, and the Caddyfiles are left out

connections is a sample of 25 points: the generated GraphQL schema and the operations, the Tauri commands invoked by the desktop front end, the agent and webapp-server routes, the bundle built for the desktop, the shared packages and the database
